gates.detail: ARDHI loading and dump duties depend on verified ramp, weight, restraint, tongue-load and tow-vehicle suitability.

restrictions: Trailer is not owned or available for SmashPro work or rental.
The dealer's 14,000-lb GVWR and 5,200-lb tare are unverified for the exact VIN; listed 8,800-lb payload is arithmetic and must be cross-checked against the certification plate.
The reported 10,500-lb distributed ramp rating and 12,000-lb hoist rating do not increase the trailer's certified payload.
ARDHI must not push or tow the 5,200-lb trailer without separately documented tow/coupler rating, approved attachment and controlled terrain; a mini skid is not presumed adequate.
The inoperable F-150 may be stationary for the dealer's registration photo only; road towing requires an operable, appropriately rated, legal tow vehicle.
4-ft sidewalls are dealer-listed for green stock #64598; 2-ft walls belong to a separate black comparison trailer. Physical measurement pending.
Dealer listing images remain attributed; publication/derivative reuse rights and actual inventory status must be confirmed.

records.title: Underbody ramps and loading gate
records.detail: Dealer reports underbody ramps rated 10,500 lb distributed; verify physical length, width, deployment angle, track contact and rear-gate opening.

records.title: Four D-ring tie-downs
records.detail: Dealer-reported four rings; locations, attachment structure and working load limits not yet proven in photos or documents.

records.title: Tarp and telescopic hoist
records.detail: Manual tarp reported, 3-stage telescopic lift publicly listed; dealer-reported 12,000-lb hoist rating to be verified separately.

records.title: Jack and spare deferred
records.detail: No electric tongue-jack upgrade or spare wheel is included as confirmed in this stock candidate. A matching spare rim/tire may be purchased separately later.

records.title: Brakes
records.value: Electric brakes on both axles + breakaway (dealer reported)

records.title: ARDHI ramp loading / unloading
records.detail: Confirm physical clearance, track contact, ramp WLL, traction, angle and tow-unit restraint before first transport.

records.title: D-ring securement and load geometry
records.detail: Verify rated D-ring WLL, attachment point layout, tongue load and manufacturer's load-distribution guidance.

records.title: Dump function and gate inspection
records.detail: Inspect hydraulics, mechanical body safety prop, raised-bed clearance, gate latches and any electrical system under supervision.

records.title: Delivery and VIN acceptance
records.detail: Inspect exact stock unit, plate, tires, axle labels, lights, brakes, breakaway, coupler and bill of sale before commissioning.
